verdict.rationale: The skills CLI installs the same repo collection into several agents in one command (`-a claude-code -a opencode`). It supports OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and 70+ more harnesses, and writes each agent's own `./<agent>/skills/` directory, symlinked to a single canonical copy. Community comments about symlink workarounds concern updating, not multi-agent installation, so they do not contradict this. Missing for 10: detailed per-harness instructions beyond the generic per-agent path table and supported-agents list, and hands-on corroboration of a multi-agent install (the runtime probes only cover --version and --list).
